entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I bought this so-called 'Aero Race Jersey' and it's a joke. I need to return it immediately.

I'm very sorry to hear about the issue with your order. I can definitely look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference on the fit?

Preference? It's the wrong size entirely! It's so ridiculously tight I can barely get it on. I need to exchange this thing, and I'm not paying to ship it back. This is your company's fault for having such terrible sizing charts. I want to speak to a manager!

I understand your frustration completely, and there's no need to speak to a manager, I'm empowered to resolve this for you right now. Let me just pull up your order details. Can I get your order number or the email address you used?
It's sam.jones@email.com. And you better resolve it. I'm one click away from leaving reviews everywhere about this.

Thank you, Mr. Jones. I'm looking at your order now. I see the Aero Race Jersey was delivered just six days ago. I can confirm you're well within our 90-day return window. I can process a return for a full refund or an exchange for a different size right now. Which would you prefer?
Wait, really? That easy? No restocking fee or garbage like that?

Absolutely not. Since it's a sizing issue and you're a valued VIP customer, we'll take care of everything. I'm generating a pre-paid return shipping label that I'll email to you in the next five minutes. For the inconvenience of receiving a jersey that was too tight, I've also added a $20 credit to your account for your next purchase.
Oh. Well... okay then. A pre-paid label and a credit? That's... actually very helpful. I'll do the exchange for one size up.
Excellent. I have processed the exchange for a size Large, and you'll receive that email with the return label shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mr. Jones?
No, that's it. Thank you, Charlie.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
